scope: Exploratory source-feature pairings only. Prior coder sheets and addendum were inspected; these pairings are not holdouts or independent confirmations.
source: ../stage2/addendum_s2/ADDENDUM.md and the pinned A/B sheets, especially S1283 notes

feature_aliases.lineage: Sartaba 1981–84 excavation, Herodian peristyle, reported by Zertal Vol.4 p.471
feature_aliases.basis: Both coders name the same small pool in the Herodian peristyle. The same source gives east-part location. This pairs a documented feature group and does not independently verify that archaeological phase.

feature_aliases.lineage: SWP Kurn Surtubeh field description, Mem II p.398
feature_aliases.basis: Both coders name the cemented cave-cisterns supplied by the aqueduct. A transfers the aqueduct's north-side direction to the cisterns; B gives the cisterns no position.

feature_aliases.lineage: Sartaba summit pits described in SWP Mem II p.397 and Zertal Vol.4 p.461; explicit identification in the B sheet's notes
feature_aliases.basis: Zertal identifies the SWP pits with the robbing pits. A accepts no unit-relative north direction; B codes the northern-area phrase as north. The publication deduces 19th-century digging while leaving other possibilities, so both retain U.

feature_aliases.lineage: Finkelstein 1985 Shiloh excavation, Area M silo 2009, p.155 / fig.12 p.156
feature_aliases.basis: Both coders describe the Area M Iron Age I silo reused in the Roman period; figure/page wording differs between citations.

feature_aliases.lineage: Finkelstein 1985 Shiloh excavation, Area K silo 1207, fig.11 p.154
feature_aliases.basis: Both coders identify silo 1207 in Area K; citations give the same figure and page.

feature_aliases.lineage: SWP Tell es Sultan spring reservoir description, Mem III entry beginning p.220; A locates passage p.223
feature_aliases.basis: Both feature records use the identical 24-by-40-foot reservoir wording and east direction. Their page citations differ (A p.223; B entry-start p.220); original passage-page check remains outstanding. Same documented reservoir, date U.

limits: Computed citation/class keys establish compatibility of a publication location and feature class only. They establish no feature identity, even if each coder supplies only one feature at that key; separate features on the same page can share a key. Exact documentary identity uses only the explicitly curated source-feature anchors above.
WBADB is a compiled record; separate WBADB/source-2/source-4 descriptions need upstream lineage checking before counting independent support.
A D date code means the coded feature predates 135 CE under the frozen rule; D does not establish contemporaneity among selected features.
A U date code passes the frozen rarity screen but establishes no ancient date.
The survey branch permits separate northern pit and grave witnesses; its positive status does not establish graves at a particular pit mouth.
Packet geometries and source excerpts are absent from the repository; a missing grid witness cannot be reconstructed from its condition status alone.
